name: Sreng Ileach
source:
"Leave it to me. I'm a Great Sorcerer (Wizard) in a league of my own—"

Sreng is a fresh face at Einsel Magic Academy. Though unremarkable as a mage, he's got a razor-sharp tactical mind and a knack for thinking outside the box. 

Driven by a desire to become a hero and protect what he holds dear, Sreng earned the right to contract with [url=/c135124]Lia[/url], one of the "Fairy Brides." This achievement has thrust him into the spotlight, attracting a mix of intrigue and envy from his peers across the academy.

Typically, Sreng exudes confidence and affability, with a sunny disposition that draws others to him. However, he occasionally surprises himself with flashes of cold detachment, moments that leave him perplexed by the complexities of his own nature.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_sreng.html]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Alard is Sreng's alternative persona, Lumiaria's loved one before she was turned into the Bride, Ria.[/spoiler]
